brief.meaningEn: Expand an organisation’s work into a genuinely new type of activity while retaining its existing core.
brief.meaningZh: 一個機構在保留原有核心工作的同時，擴展到真正不同的新活動類別。
brief.grammar: An organisation branches out into a new service, field or activity. The source says newer lanes, mixing road and tree metaphors; learner models use natural branch out into new areas/services. Name the old core and the new line.
brief.register: A library manager describing a service plan to trustees, or a cooperative leader briefing members, may use this ordinary professional phrase without claiming the expansion has succeeded.
brief.boundaryZh: 須是擴展到不同類別的活動；只增加同一服務的時段或數量，不等於 branch out。
brief.misconceptionZh: 來源的 newer lanes 是混合比喻，不應當作固定搭配照抄；本課也不等於放棄原有核心。
brief.outcomeZh: 能指出原本業務、新類別、試行或資源界限，並分清擴展與單純增量。

sources.file: Idiomatic and Natural English Expressions Books 10 to 16 Part 3.docx
sources.locatorNote: DOCX table 29, row 3; page refers to the locally rendered PDF recorded in the intake summary.
sources.sentence: The company is branching out into newer lanes this year.

listening.en: The neighbourhood library still lends books, but this year it began lending gardening tools and teaching basic repairs. It is branching out into practical-skills services; staff will review demand before buying more equipment.
listening.zh: 社區圖書館仍借出圖書，但今年開始借出園藝工具，並教授簡單維修。它正擴展到實用技能服務；員工會先檢討需求，再購買更多器材。
listening.promptZh: 圖書館如何 branching out into 新領域？

options.en: It added tool lending and repair teaching beyond its book service.
options.zh: 它在借書服務以外加入工具借用和維修教學。

options.en: It stopped lending books and only shortened opening hours.
options.zh: 它停止借書，只縮短開放時間。

options.en: It lent more copies of the same titles but offered no new activity.
options.zh: 它只是多借出同一批書的副本，沒有新活動。

options.en: It bought all possible tools before checking whether anyone wanted them.
options.zh: 它未查需求便買下所有可買的工具。

listening.explanationZh: 借工具和教維修是借書以外的新服務類別；增加同一批書的數量則不是。

reply.promptEn: A sports club still runs training sessions but has started a small nutrition workshop series for members. Why might the committee describe this as an expansion?
reply.promptZh: 一間體育會仍舉辦訓練班，最近為會員試辦一系列小型營養工作坊。委員會為何可說這是擴展？

options.en: It is adding a different kind of service alongside training.
options.zh: 它在訓練以外加入另一類服務。

options.en: The workshops take the club into education while training continues.
options.zh: 訓練繼續，工作坊則把體育會帶到教育領域。

options.en: The club is branching out into nutrition education.
options.zh: 體育會正擴展到營養教育。

options.en: The committee can test interest in a new service without abandoning the core sessions.
options.zh: 委員會可在保留核心訓練的同時測試新服務的需求。

reply.explanationZh: 四句都指出訓練以外多了營養教育；金句自然使用 branch out into。

scene.promptZh: 麵包店保留日常烘焙售賣，另試辦教顧客製作酸種麵包的週末課程。哪句最貼切？

options.en: The bakery is branching out into weekend baking classes while still selling bread.
options.zh: 麵包店仍售麵包，同時擴展到週末烘焙課。

options.en: The bakery is only baking more of the same loaves, with no new service.
options.zh: 麵包店只是增加同款麵包產量，沒有新服務。

options.en: The bakery has closed its shop and ended all bread sales.
options.zh: 麵包店已關門，完全停止賣麵包。

scene.explanationZh: 教學是售賣麵包以外的新類別，原有業務仍在。

contrast.promptZh: 哪個情況最不適合說機構 branches out into a new area？

options.en: A repair cooperative adds supervised bicycle maintenance to its radio work.
options.zh: 維修合作社在修收音機之外加入有人指導的單車維修。

options.en: A cinema starts running film-making workshops alongside screenings.
options.zh: 戲院在放映以外開設電影製作工作坊。

options.en: A bookshop sells more copies of the same books without offering a new service.
options.zh: 書店只增加同款書的銷量，沒有推出新服務。

contrast.explanationZh: 最後一項只擴大原有銷量，沒有進入新的活動類別。

dialogue.promptEn:
A: The theatre will still stage plays, but it wants to rent costumes to local schools as a small pilot. Are we leaving theatre work behind?
B: ?
dialogue.promptZh:
甲：劇院仍會上演戲劇，但想小規模試行把戲服租給本地學校。我們是在放棄劇院工作嗎？
乙：？

options.en: No. We are branching out into costume rental while keeping our productions.
options.zh: 不是。我們會保留演出，同時擴展到戲服租賃。

options.en: Yes. Renting one costume means every play must close at once.
options.zh: 是。只要租出一件戲服，所有戲劇便要立即停演。

options.en: No. Costume rental is exactly the same activity as staging a play, so nothing changes.
options.zh: 不是。戲服租賃與上演戲劇完全相同，因此沒有改變。

dialogue.explanationZh: 戲服租賃是演出以外的新服務，而劇院仍保留原本製作。

speaking.en: The local history society branched out into guided walking tours after years of archiving photographs, but it began with one small trial route.
speaking.zh: 本地歷史學會多年來整理相片檔案，後來擴展到導賞步行團，但起初只試行一條短路線。
speaking.promptZh: 先聽示範，再指出原本工作、新服務和試行界限。

writing.promptZh: 新情境：科學博物館原本只辦館內展覽，現試行把可借用的實驗套裝送到學校。用英文說明原有核心、新活動及如何審慎測試需求。
writing.selfCheckZh: 說出展覽仍然保留、可借用套裝屬新服務，以及試行和檢討方法；不能只說博物館「做得更多」。

examples.en: The museum is branching out into school kit loans while keeping its exhibitions. It will lend ten experiment sets first and ask teachers which activities pupils actually use.
examples.zh: 博物館保留館內展覽，同時擴展到學校實驗套裝借用。它會先借出十套，再問老師學生實際使用哪些活動。

examples.en: Exhibitions remain the museum’s core work, but it branched out into lending experiment kits to schools. A one-term trial will show whether teachers need more sets.
examples.zh: 展覽仍是博物館的核心工作，但它已擴展到向學校借出實驗套裝。一學期試行可讓館方知道老師是否需要更多套裝。

takeaways.en: A small bakery branched out into classes only after checking that customers wanted them.
takeaways.zh: 小麵包店確認顧客有興趣後，才擴展到課程。

takeaways.en: Selling more of the same product is growth, but it is not necessarily branching out into a new area.
takeaways.zh: 多賣原有產品是增長，但未必算擴展到新領域。
